dossier_meta.authors: Hoang, Chinh T., Reed, Bruce A.
dossier_meta.subject: Graph Theory » Directed Graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Conjecture Every digraph in which each vertex has outdegree at least $ k $ contains $ k $ directed cycles $ C_1, \ldots, C_k $ such that $ C_j $ meets $ \cup_{i=1}^{j-1}C_i $ in at most one vertex, $ 2 \leq j \leq k $ .
dossier_meta.context_text: This conjecture is not even known to be true for $ k=3 $ . In the case $ k=2 $ , Thomassen proved [T] that every digraph with minimum outdegree 2 has two directed cycles intersecting on a vertex. This conjecture would imply the Caccetta-Häggkvist Conjecture .
dossier_meta.references_text:
- *[HR] C.T. Hoàng and B. Reed, A note on short cycles in digraphs, Discrete Math., 66 (1987), 103-107.
- [T] C. Thomassen, The 2-linkage problem for acyclic digraphs, Discrete Math., 55 (1985), 73-87.
